marc:datafield.marc:subfield: This is a story of a young college student Chris, the only child in a struggling single parent family and his exciting and yet dangerous journey into Malaysia's dark and shady underworld of crime and piracy run by vicious gangsters. Unfortunately for Chris along with the "money", so called respect and glamorous life, comes the loss of family, friendship and true love as he is unable to escape the deeper dark abyss that becomes his life. The movie's leading casts include Ernest Chong Shun Yuan (Best Supporting Actor Award during the recent NTV7's Golden Awards), Chye Yang, Carrine Chong Su Sian and Ganesh Venugopal.
